body.x: [Pipeline Position] Program Director, VEA4A (Africa Regional Office) [Based in Kigali]
***This is a pipeline position created to prepare for anticipated hiring needs. Final hiring decisions will be made following internal review processes.***

We are seeking a Program Director, VEA4A for 2-year-regular position (renewable) to work within Africa Regional Office at the International Vaccine Institute in Kigali, Rwanda. (Duty station: Kigali, Rwanda)

This role is responsible for providing executive leadership for the VEA4A Programme and is accountable for delivering its training, employment, inclusion, institutional-strengthening and sustainability outcomes across the five participating higher-education institutions. It encompasses setting programme direction, leading the Rwanda Secretariat, and managing engagement with strategic partners and the Joint Steering Committee.
Set the strategic direction and implementation priorities for the programme within the approved grant, workplan and budget.
Form and lead the Rwanda Secretariat for the VEA4A programme and hold the core team accountable for programme results, quality and timely delivery.

Approve operational adjustments to delivery support and sequencing, corrective actions and resource prioritisation, and recommend HEI activation and strategic adaptations to the Joint Steering Committee.
Maintain executive oversight of programme quality, safeguarding, inclusion, data governance and material risk.
Use implementation, labour-market and MEL evidence to make strategic decisions and direct corrective action.
2. Leadership of strategic partnerships and engagement with the Joint Steering Committee
Lead senior engagement with the Mastercard Foundation, ARUA, HEI leadership, governments, regulators, manufacturers, Africa CDC and other strategic partners.
Maintain executive oversight of partner performance.
Serve as the principal management interface with the Joint Steering Committee and ensure that its decisions are implemented.
Represent VEA4A and IVI in relevant senior policy, technical, donor and sector forums.
3. Programme integration, institutionalisation and sustainability planning
Facilitate technical review, assessment moderation, remediation and continuous improvement, and follow up on corrective actions.
Review training materials and delivery against validated industry and regulatory competency requirements.
Facilitate the progressive transfer of curricula, faculty capability, delivery processes and quality-assurance practices to HEIs.
Doctoral degree in public health, health sciences, life sciences, pharmacy, biotechnology, education, workforce development, management or another field relevant to the programme.
Substantial senior leadership experience commensurate with responsibility for a large workforce-development, training or institutional-capacity programme.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams, complex partnerships and donor-funded programmes.
Experience working with higher-education institutions, preferably in Africa or LMICs, and with industry, regulatory or government partners.
Sufficient understanding of vaccine manufacturing, biomanufacturing, regulatory systems and technical workforce development to exercise sound programme judgement within the role’s responsibilities.
Clear communication across technical and non-technical audiences.
***IVI welcomes applications from all sections of the community. We encourage women to apply, especially from countries that are currently under-represented within IVI.***
